.github/workflows/member-auth.yml:
name: Member authentication checks
on:
  push:
    branches: [feat/member-auth-registration]
  pull_request:
    branches: [feat/fafa-one-control-panel]
    paths:
      - 'packages/auth/**'
      - 'apps/api/src/member-auth.ts'
      - 'apps/web/src/member/**'
      - 'tests/member-auth*'
      - 'tests/e2e/member-auth.spec.ts'
      - '.github/workflows/member-auth.yml'
permissions: { contents: read }
concurrency:
  group: member-auth-${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  member-auth:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17.7-alpine
        env:
          {
            POSTGRES_DB: fafa,
            POSTGRES_USER: fafa,
            POSTGRES_PASSWORD: fafa_dev_only,
          }
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U fafa" --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - name: Free disk space for browser matrix
        run: |
          df -h
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android /opt/ghc /usr/local/share/boost || true
          sudo apt-get clean || true
          df -h
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: '24' }
      - run: npm install -g pnpm@11.25.0
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm exec tsx infra/scripts/init-env.ts
      - name: Verify independent files and formatting
        run: pnpm exec tsx infra/scripts/check-member-isolation.ts --format
      - run: pnpm format:check
      - run: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck
      - run: bash -n infra/scripts/deploy-production.sh infra/scripts/production-compose.sh infra/scripts/backup-production.sh
      - run: python3 -m unittest discover -s infra/deploy -p 'test_*.py'
      - name: Read-only integration preview against the observed Muse branch
        run: pnpm exec tsx infra/scripts/member-integration-preview.ts --artifact
      - name: Unit, real PostgreSQL and authentication security tests
        run: pnpm test:member
      - name: Existing API, Google and unique Owner regression
        run: pnpm test:integration
      - run: pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm security && pnpm audit --audit-level=moderate
      - name: Prepare isolated browser fixture
        run: pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
      - run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium firefox webkit
      - name: Member browser interactions
        run: pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/member-auth.spec.ts --project=chromium --project=webkit --project=iphone
      - name: WLOC iPhone and WebKit viewport regression before full matrix
        run: pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/wloc.spec.ts --project=iphone --project=webkit --grep='WLOC responsive' --max-failures=1
      - name: Check disk before browser matrix
        run: df -h
      - name: Complete browser matrix preserving existing UI
        run: pnpm test:e2e
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: member-auth-test-evidence
          path: |
            docs/evidence/playwright.json
            docs/evidence/member-integration-preview.json
            test-results/
            docs/screenshots/
            docs/AXE_REPORT.json
  windows-launcher:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - name: Validate Windows PowerShell launcher syntax
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $parseTokens = $null
          $parseErrors = $null
          [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile(
            (Join-Path $PWD 'infra/scripts/start-windows.ps1'),
            [ref]$parseTokens,
            [ref]$parseErrors
          ) | Out-Null
          if ($parseErrors.Count -gt 0) {
            $parseErrors | ForEach-Object { Write-Error $_.Message }
            exit 1
          }
          Write-Host 'Windows PowerShell 5.1 syntax validation passed.'
      - name: Verify Windows registry proxy inheritance in a child process
        shell: powershell
        run: .\infra\scripts\verify-windows-proxy.ps1
  containers:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: '24' }
      - run: npm install -g pnpm@11.25.0
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm exec tsx infra/scripts/init-env.ts
      - name: Build and start isolated development services
        run: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.dev.yaml -f infra/docker/compose.tls-test.yaml up --build -d --wait --wait-timeout 120
      - name: Validate production Caddy configuration
        run: >-
          docker run --rm -i
          -e PANEL_DOMAIN=fafa888.uk -e ADMIN_DOMAIN=a.fafa888.uk
          caddy:2.10.2-alpine caddy adapt --config - --adapter caddyfile --validate
          < infra/reverse-proxy/Caddyfile > /tmp/fafa-caddy-adapt.json
      - run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Verify Caddy HTTPS and API boundaries
        timeout-minutes: 3
        run: |
          for repetition in 1 2 3; do
            pnpm verify:tls
          done
      - name: Retain service health evidence
        if: always()
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/evidence
          docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.dev.yaml ps --all --format json > docs/evidence/compose.json
          docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.dev.yaml logs --tail=50 > /tmp/fafa-compose.log
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: container-evidence
          path: docs/evidence/
      - name: Stop test services, preserve production resources
        if: always()
        run: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.dev.yaml down
  production-startup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: '24' }
      - name: Check deployment shell syntax
        run: bash -n infra/scripts/deploy-production.sh infra/scripts/repository-git.sh infra/scripts/verify-production-startup.sh
      - name: Verify root uses the existing repository identity
        run: |
          expected="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          observed="$(sudo bash -c 'cd "$1"; source infra/scripts/repository-git.sh; repository_git rev-parse HEAD' _ "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE")"
          test "$expected" = "$observed"
      - name: Verify first deployment with disposable credentials and volumes
        run: bash infra/scripts/verify-production-startup.sh
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: production-startup-evidence
          path: |
            docs/evidence/production-startup.json
            docs/evidence/production-startup-containers.json

docs/PR8_WLOC_REGRESSION.md:
# PR #8 WLOC iPhone 回归与整合交接

基线：cd1a36269e67f5d0bdc26d959474d9dc467ca24a（feat/member-auth-integration-b4dd0cea）。
原始失败：Member authentication checks #29 / Actions 42390559508；主工作流 #102 已取消。

## 已读取的证据

原始 member-auth-test-evidence artifact 13582362260 包含 Playwright JSON、iPhone trace、error-context 与 PNG。
通过仅 contents:read/actions:read 的独立诊断分支 codex/pr8-wloc-evidence 在临时 GitHub runner 读取；不访问 AWS。
诊断仅输出动作类型、时长、宽度、错误状态、固定按钮名称和一张合成测试画面；
不会输出 trace 的 Cookie、CSRF、Authorization、网络正文或个人账户凭据。
本地 shell 因此前 bwrap 限制未执行，没有再次尝试绕过。

原日志：108 passed、6项既有条件跳过、1 failed；iPhone 在原单例60秒截止后报 context closed。
该轮矩阵前磁盘尚余约27GiB，未见 ENOSPC；不能把历史磁盘问题当作本次根因。
trace 表明同一用例连续执行375、390、430、768、1440px，逐次应用坐标与主题切换。
多次点击分别耗时2–8秒，至1440px主题切换与整页截图已耗尽用例总预算。
context/browser closed 是计时器终止后的后续错误，不构成浏览器自行崩溃证据。
CI竞争可能放大时长，但原日志无CPU/OOM证据，不把它写成已证实根因。

## 修复范围与覆盖

仅修改测试结构、截图策略、定向CI步骤和本说明；不修改应用、Google/Owner、节点、数据库或持久数据。
五种宽度改为五个独立60秒用例；每种仍验证浅色与深色、主题双向切换、无横向溢出、
坐标输入/应用与选中值、保存按钮启用。增加滚动后处于视口内与中心命中检查，真实遮挡会失败。
不提高全局或单例超时，不删除断言、不新增skip、不添加固定等待。

截图使用有限视口与CSS像素，避免iPhone DPR=3的整页巨大位图；
各浅深主题PNG按testInfo.outputPath隔离并附加到报告，不写入生产或公开文件。
协议操作用例仍执行全部真实收藏API与设备夹具断言，仅将其证据截图改为有限视口/CSS像素。

## 验收范围

定向iPhone/WebKit布局先于各工作流完整矩阵；主CI与账户专项CI均须在最终SHA通过。
必须保留20项账户/邮箱/增量升级安全测试、现有API与Owner测试、全部浏览器、
Docker HTTPS、数据库持久化、备份恢复和原有UI/节点回归。
自动浏览器与合成模块结果不是实际iPhone定位、真实邮件收件或正式Google/Owner登录验收。

## 发布边界

生产发布必须复核当前实际生产SHA、备份、迁移005运行时角色权限及环境配置，
保留现有Owner、密钥、.env.production和Docker卷。公开注册保持关闭，直至持有人完成真实邮件验收。
只通过既有受保护SSM/OIDC部署；没有该执行权限、required review或指定SHA批准时交接，不宣称部署。
PR #5在本次接管时HEAD为aaa249242e7b52e9542898e74c4c2cca18bff160，主CI #99成功、PR仍open且未merged；
生产是否含该功能需实际执行通道证据，不凭CI或PR状态推断已上线。
轮换后且有合法使用/再分发授权的真实节点须通过可信HTTPS管理页面导入；本轮未导入，
Shadowrocket/v2rayN真机网络与iOS WLOC实效保留为待实际验收。
自带Codex账户与自有服务器执行继续保留后续计划，本修复不开发该功能。
